description: Going Commando's Charge Boots charge on Clank's Thruster-Pack, running Going Commando's own code: with the Thruster-Pack on, double-tap R1 and hold to charge, steering with the stick; flames turn blue and enemies in the way are hit. Needs the hook points of OpenRAC #617.

screenshots.caption: A charge down a tunnel on Clank's Thruster-Pack, its flames blue.
